mapper.select: SELECT l.mission_id as resource_id, t.name, DATE_FORMAT(t.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as start_time, DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS end_time FROM cr_eval_mission_template_log as l left join cr_eval_mission_template as t on l.mission_id = t.resource_id WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} and t.status in (5,6) GROUP BY l.mission_id;
